Sasha: Quick show-and-tell — turned the shower curtain into a budget green screen and jury-rigged a ring light with binder clips. Pics: https://i.imgur.com/abcd123.jpg :grin:
Owen: that looks shockingly legit for 3 binder clips :joy:
Maya: omg please tell me your secret. also how's the audio with that setup?
Sasha: honestly decent. list: `IKEA floor pole`, `white shower curtain`, `binder clips`, `command hooks`, cheap LED ring light. Mic was picking up a low hum from the ceiling fan though.
Raj: fan hum is the worst. have you tried moving the mic off the desk or using a foam pop filter?
Sasha: moved mic onto a jar lid (yeah, really) to isolate vibration and it helped. also angled the fan away during calls = instant improvement :ok_hand:
Alex: random PSA — my building's ISP is flaking, went down for ~10m earlier. anyone else seeing weird latency?
Maya: same here in SF. outage map shows maintenance. guess it's a global conspiracy to make us join video meetings in person :crying_cat_face:
Owen: if needed I can spot you a hotspot for an hour (limited data). happy to help.
Sasha: thanks! trying low fan speed first — hum reduced a LOT :tada:
deploy-bot: deploy-2026-03-23 at 1767777790 — prod deploy succeeded :rocket:
Raj: haha unrelated but nice timing, congrats team :party_parrot:
Alex: glued a bit of foam under my mic stand last week, saved me from buying an isolator. 10/10 would recommend thrift hacks.
Maya: can we get a step-by-step in #devex? would love a mini guide for green screen + audio hacks.
Sasha: will write a 2-min thread with photos tonight and post it. thanks for the tips y'all :heart:
